notes: Identity assessment: supplied candidate is a primary BRIEF RESEARCH REPORT, published 24 May 2019, with matching full title, Perez/Jaundoo/Hilton/Del Alamo/Gemayel/Klimas/Craddock/Nathanson authors and DOI 10.3389/fped.2019.00206 on p. 1; seven-page article text includes Methods, Results, Table 1, and references. No PDF was supplied; no acquisition or rendering performed. Target matched independently by the named gene and its unique Table 1 SNP row, not row order or numeric agreement. The table compares SNP frequency in ME/CFS with Kaviar; it does not test the functional biological relationships themselves. Printed metric is Frequency ratio, not OR; no conversion performed. The abstract reports 383 genotyped ME/CFS participants, but Methods and Table 1 do not give the analytic denominator for this SNP or the corresponding Kaviar reference sample. No per-SNP missing-call/exclusion accounting or final mutually exclusive group counts are supplied. The cohort total is retained only as a contributor-count candidate, not established as analytic N. Table 1 reports ME/CFS frequency, Kaviar frequency, frequency ratio, and C-score for this SNP, with no p value. Methods describe a frequency comparison/selection rule; the p-value cutoff 0.01 on pp. 2–3 applies to pathway over-representation, not this SNP frequency ratio, and cannot be assigned to this comparison. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders.
